prompt: Scene: An old attic room at dusk with a wooden map table and an open treasure chest beneath a round window. Dust motes drift through a warm golden beam. A hand-drawn map lies on the table beside a compass, a lantern, and stacks of forgotten boxes. Lighting and palette: warm sunset light, amber and dusty brown palette with soft blue shadows. Art style: modern flat-color cartoon illustration style, bold clean black outlines, simplified shapes, smooth flat shading with minimal texture, bright saturated colors. Composition: a single full-page book illustration with a portrait aspect ratio of approximately 2:3, no characters or people in the scene. The scene fills the entire page edge to edge with no text, letters, writing, signs or symbols rendered anywhere in the image.
